note: 게임 파일 값이며 게임 안 실측값이 아니다. scu 와 pc(낱개)는 다른 단위다. 한 칸의 선택지(o)가 여럿이면 그중에서 고르는 것이고 합치지 않는다.

unknowns.poolDraw: BlueprintPoolRecord lists blueprints with a weight (all 1 in this build). The file does not say whether one blueprint is drawn per completion or all are granted, nor how already-owned blueprints are treated. A pool may list the same blueprint more than once; entries are kept as in the file and what a repeat means is not verified.
unknowns.modifierApply: mods[].r values are the file values (modifierAtStart / modifierAtEnd, or the additive pair when add is 1). The record type says they change linearly between startQuality and endQuality; that a non-additive value is a multiplier of the base stat is our reading and is not stated in the files, least of all for stats without a display transformation (temperature, fire rate, integrity, damage mitigation).
unknowns.statStacking: How two slots that change the same stat combine (add or multiply) is not stated in the files.
unknowns.inclusion: inc is CraftingCostContext_ResultCompositionInclusion.option as written (1 Include, 0 Exclude). Its effect on what dismantling returns is not stated in the files.
unknowns.quantityMultiplier: x is CraftingCostContext_QuantityMultiplier.multiplier. Whether the game multiplies the listed amount by it is not verified; scu / pc are the unmultiplied file values.
unknowns.dismantle: efficiency and s are the generic dismantle values; how efficiency turns into returned amounts (rounding, quality) is not stated in the files.
unknowns.tradeMax: A trade requirement with max 0 and min above 0 is written that way in the files (almost half of the item rows); whether 0 means "no upper limit" is not verified.
unknowns.tradeOverrideUnused: A trade with ovUnused carries a hauling override (MissionPropertyValue_HaulingOrders) whose mission variable its template never reads. That content is not in need; whether the game uses it anyway is not verified.
unknowns.tradeAccess: tradeAccess lists contract prerequisites as written (completed-contract tag names, crime stat range, reputation standing with its minReputation). Which contract gives a tag, and whether rep.max is an upper limit the player must not exceed, are not verified.
unknowns.tempBlueprints: tempBlueprints lists MissionModifier_TemporaryBlueprint entries (a mission modifier that names a pool). What "temporary" means in play and whether these modifiers are used by released contracts is not verified.
unknowns.stationCategories: stations[].make.cats / dismantle.cats can hold category ids that no blueprint uses and that are therefore not in categories[].
unknowns.tradeRoll: roll[].w is ItemAwardWeightings.weighting as written; with a single group its meaning (chance or relative weight) is not verified.
unknowns.modifierRange: A modifier without r names a stat but the file gives no value range (null pointer). partial marks a modifier where only some ranges were null.
unknowns.stationLocations: Where fabricators stand in the world is not in the records read here.
unknowns.sources: A blueprint that is in no pool and is not default-owned has no source in this file; shops and loot are not covered. Which contracts award a pool is in the missions data, not here.
unknowns.eventTiers: eventTiers lists scenario reward tiers that name a pool; whether the event is running is decided by the server.
